summary: Implemented global frontend responsiveness and modern design optimizations across the PortalSifast project. Key changes: (1) Fixed double padding across 60+ pages — all inner p-4 wrappers removed, layout AppSidebarLayout remains the single source of padding; (2) Fixed heading.tsx mb-8 double-spacing with flex gap containers; (3) Fixed FlashMessage mobile overflow with left-4 right-4 responsive positioning; (4) Modernized TemplateHeader with user initials avatar, breadcrumb trail on desktop, and cleaner layout; (5) Redesigned web-official/index.tsx with fully-clickable module cards, unique icon colors per module, and staggered entrance animation; (6) Added 7 new global CSS utility classes (table-responsive, page-container, module-card, stat-card, form-section, avatar-initials, filter-bar) to app.css. Fixed a Tailwind v4 @apply group bug. All 28 tests pass, build succeeded in 17.89s.
current_status: PortalSifast admin panel now has consistent, non-doubled padding across all 60+ pages, a modern header with user initials, responsive flash messages, and a modernized web-official dashboard. The web-official module is fully implemented (Berita, Kamar, Promosi, Poliklinik, Instagram Feed, Berita Eksternal RSS) with public and admin APIs, Inertia admin panels, scheduled sync, and comprehensive tests. Next potential tasks: individual page modernization (tickets board, simmutu dashboard), notification bell wiring, or frontend website integration work.
